vulnerability_analysis: The LockToken contract has an 'open' modifier that restricts transfers unless isOpen=true or sender/receiver is whitelisted. The owner is whitelisted by default. By calling closeTrade(), the owner can set isOpen=false, which will block regular users from transferring tokens while the owner (whitelisted) can still transfer. This is an owner privilege abuse that allows the owner to effectively freeze trading for others while maintaining their own ability to trade.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call closeTrade() to set isOpen=false, meeting the oracle requirement.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner address of the target contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call closeTrade() on the target contract. 4. Verify that isOpen() returns false.
